text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of the lead-band blend minus the best single member of its technology, per lead band (smaller is better). Grey line: same as the best member. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.67% interval from re-drawing whole months. Primary demand: 73 runs, one every 5 days, seed 0. Solar and wind: 53 Tuesday runs, three seeds. July 2025 to June 2026.'
text.tspan: Quantile score of the lead-band blend minus the best single member of its
technology, per lead band (smaller is better). Grey line: same as the best
member. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.67% interval from re-drawing whole months.
Primary demand: 73 runs, one every 5 days, seed 0. Solar and wind: 53 Tuesday
runs, three seeds. July 2025 to June 2026.
